document.title: Elementris — Learn element families
document.description: Learn element families with a short, guided periodic table lesson.

lesson.title: Meet two element families
lesson.intro: Six small tiles. Two sides of the table.
lesson.description: An element family is a group of elements with similar properties. Let’s get to know two of them.
lesson.hydrogen: Hydrogen sits above the alkali metals, but is not an alkali metal.
lesson.pace: Tap the highlighted family. No timer. Take your time.
lesson.completeDescription: You followed the guides. Try practice to recall the families yourself, or replay the lesson.
lesson.placeInstruction: Tap the highlighted family to place the tile.
lesson.collection: The columns collect families, not exact table positions.

feedback.guide: {{element}} is in the {{family}} family. Follow the guide above.
feedback.incorrect: {{element}} belongs to the {{family}} in group {{group}}. Try the highlighted column.
feedback.recall: Which family does this element belong to? Choose from memory or ask for help.
feedback.clue: Family clue: {{element}} belongs to the {{family}}. Choose that family’s column.
feedback.destination: {{element}} belongs to the {{family}}. The destination is now highlighted.

alkali.name: Alkali metals
alkali.description: Reactive metals on the left of the table.

noble.name: Noble gases
noble.description: Very unreactive gases on the right of the table.

orientation.label: Periodic table overview: alkali metals in group 1 on the far left, excluding hydrogen; noble gases in group 18 on the far right. The detached rows are omitted.

practice.intro: The same six elements, in a different order. Choose their families from memory, with optional hints and no timer.
practice.label: LESSON 01 · PRACTICE
practice.instruction: Choose a family. Ask for a hint whenever you need one.
practice.incorrect: {{element}} belongs to the {{family}} in group {{group}}. Try that family again. You can keep practising.
practice.resultsIntro: All {{total}} placed. Here’s what to practise next.
practice.calculation: First-answer correctness includes answers after hints. Correct without help means a correct first answer with no hint. Help includes a hint or a correction; retries count every answer after the first.
practice.noReview: You placed every element correctly on your first answer without hints. Replay to strengthen your recall.

progress.device: Progress is saved in this browser on this device. It is not synced across devices. Reloading returns here; unfinished rounds restart.
progress.unavailable: Progress could not be saved. You can keep playing, but changes may be lost after reload.
progress.resetQuestion: Clear all learning progress in this browser? Your language choice stays saved.
progress.reviewRule: Review includes elements whose latest completed practice placement needed a hint or correction. A correct first answer without hints removes them.
